# CodePipeline

### Known gaps

- Deploy/CloudFormation and the pipeline role ignore RoleArn for authorization (IAM evaluation is out of scope)

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- Rule providers other than VariableCheck and LambdaInvoke (DeploymentWindow, CloudWatchAlarm, Commands) always Succeed: no wall-clock window, alarm backend or compute to consult.
- ListActionTypes lists only custom action types; the AWS-owned and third-party built-in catalog (artifact details, settings) is AWS-owned reference data with no SDK source, so ActionOwnerFilter=AWS returns nothing.
- JobData/ThirdPartyJobData omit ArtifactCredentials, InputArtifacts, OutputArtifacts and EncryptionKey: no artifact store or STS exists to issue them.
- ListDeployActionExecutionTargets returns empty: no real deploy targets exist behind Deploy actions.
- ListWebhookItem.ErrorCode/ErrorMessage are never set: webhook registration against a third party cannot fail in an emulator.
- Built-in action providers the emulator does not implement (Build/ECRBuildAndPublish, Test/DeviceFarm, Deploy/ElasticBeanstalk, ServiceCatalog, AppConfig, OpsWorks, Alexa, CodeDeployToECS, CloudFormationStackSet, CloudFormationStackInstances, EKS, EC2, Invoke/StepFunctions, Invoke/InspectorScan, Compute/Commands) FAIL the action with ConfigurationError 'not supported by this emulator' rather than succeeding. Implemented built-ins: Manual approval, CodeBuild, Lambda, CodeDeploy, S3 source/deploy, CloudFormation deploy, ECS deploy, ECR source, CodeCommit source. Custom-owner actions are real: a Queued job is created for the worker (PollForJobs/Put*JobResult).
- Build/CodeBuild waits for the real build status, but the emulated build runs no buildspec: the primary input artifact is passed through unchanged as every output artifact, and, when the CodeBuild adapter reports them (internal/app/cli.go), the build's exported-variables become the action's outputVariables under its namespace (the CodePipeline variables reference documents no other CodeBuild variables, so CODEBUILD_* are not added); #{...} references in any action configuration are resolved before the action runs. Source/S3 and Deploy/S3 move real objects when the S3 seam is wired (internal/app/cli.go wireCodePipelineS3); the artifact store key is derived from pipeline, artifact name and execution ID. A missing source object fails the action with ConfigurationError (code chosen from the FailureType enum; the docs name none).
